feed.title: Aaron Gordon
feed.text: Gordon recorded 11 points (4-6 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 1-2 FT), a rebound and an assist across 24 minutes in Monday's 117-105 loss to the Suns.

feed.title: Duncan Robinson
feed.text: Robinson will be re-evaluated in one week due to a left quadriceps strain, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.

feed.title: Domantas Sabonis
feed.text: Sabonis finished Sunday's 125-103 loss to the Thunder with 11 points (3-6 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 5-6 FT), 13 rebounds and three assists in 29 minutes.

feed.title: Evan Mobley
feed.text: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a left great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

feed.title: Zaccharie Risacher
feed.text: Risacher recorded 18 points (8-9 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 1-2 FT) and five rebounds in 26 minutes during Sunday's 131-94 loss to the Celtics.

feed.title: Tristan da Silva
feed.text: Da Silva isn't starting Monday's game against the Celtics.

feed.title: Meleek Thomas
feed.text: Thomas will come off the bench Monday against the Bulls, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.

feed.title: Jared McCain
feed.text: McCain recorded 23 points (8-17 FG, 7-11 3Pt), four rebounds and two assists in 31 minutes during Friday's 113-112 loss to the Clippers.

feed.title: Jaime Jaquez Jr.
feed.text: Jaquez chipped in 22 points (8-15 FG, 5-7 3Pt, 1-3 FT), six rebounds and four assists in 28 minutes during Friday's 107-99 loss to the Magic.

feed.title: Caleb Wilson
feed.text: Wilson is undergoing surgery for a fractured right hand and will miss at least four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Lauri Markkanen
feed.text: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

feed.title: Dyson Daniels
feed.text: Daniels provided 10 points (4-4 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 1-2 FT), six rebounds, eight assists and four steals in 31 minutes during Monday's 124-114 loss to the Lakers.

feed.title: Ja Morant

feed.title: Jalen Duren
feed.text: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

feed.title: Kristaps Porzingis
feed.text: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

feed.title: Chet Holmgren
feed.text: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

feed.title: Anthony Edwards
feed.text: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

feed.title: Jaren Jackson Jr.
feed.text: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

feed.title: Paolo Banchero
feed.text: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

feed.title: Jimmy Butler III
feed.text: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
